correctness.rationale: The fully invariant derived subgroup forces every generator image into a unique normal form. Evaluating the presentation yields exactly the units U_(s,t), nonunits B_(k,t), and zero. The explicit composition law is checked on generators. All monoid centralizers are obtained from both unit-vs-unit and unit-vs-nonunit commutation equations and the nonunit-vs-nonunit geometric-sum equality. Crucial k*l=0 mod r boundary is treated without dividing by zero. Their counts give the full claimed polynomial and tau(r)+1 distinct sizes for r>=3. The resulting image-order, idempotent and unit-conjugacy formulas have independent elementary derivations. Reproducibility/check.py exhaustively tests all endomorphisms for seven (p,r) and full actual-group homomorphism and function-composition laws for four pairs; this supports, but does not replace, the uniform symbolic proof.

value.rationale: An all-parameter centralizer-size spectrum of a natural nonabelian endomorphism monoid is a complete structural invariant; the arithmetic divisor spectrum tau(r)+1 and sharp nonunit commuting criterion show how zero divisors in the cyclic complement alter its commuting graph. This has a natural finite-group objective rather than an arbitrary slice or unmotivated standalone number, and provides complete commuting-pair, rank, retraction and automorphism-orbit refinements.
